# std/string
String operations: length, substring, trim, split, etc.
Strings are immutable UTF-8 sequences.

Pure functions (no effects required)

## Exports

  length(string) -> int

  substring(string, int, int) -> string

  toUpper(string) -> string

  toLower(string) -> string

  trim(string) -> string

  compare(string, string) -> int
    compare: -1 / 0 / +1

  find(string, string) -> int
    returns first index or -1

  contains(string, string) -> bool
    returns true if hay contains needle

  replace(string, string, string) -> string
    replace: Replace all occurrences of old with new

  startsWith(string, string) -> bool
    startsWith: Check if string starts with prefix

  endsWith(string, string) -> bool
    endsWith: Check if string ends with suffix

  stringToInt(string) -> Option[int]
    String parsing (returns Option)

  stringToFloat(string) -> Option[float]

  split(string, string) -> list[string]
    String splitting

  chars(string) -> list[string]
    chars: Convert string to list of single-character strings

  floatToStr(float) -> string
    floatToStr: Convert a float to its string representation

  intToStr(int) -> string
    intToStr: Convert an integer to its string representation

  join(string, list[string]) -> string
    join: Concatenate list of strings with delimiter

  concat(list[string]) -> string
    concat: Concatenate a list of strings with no separator.

  repeat(string, int) -> string
    repeat: Repeat a string n times

  words(string) -> list[string]
    words: Split on whitespace (tabs, spaces, newlines), drop empties

  splitAny(string, list[string]) -> list[string]
    splitAny: Split on any of multiple single-character delimiters

  foldChars((a, string -> a), a, string) -> a
    foldChars: Fold over characters without intermediate list allocation

  charAt(string, int) -> string
    charAt: Get character at rune index (0-based) — ABORTS out of bounds

  charAtOpt(string, int) -> Option[string]
    charAtOpt: Total character access at rune index (0-based)

  charAt_or(string, int, string) -> string
    charAt_or: Character at rune index, or a caller-supplied default

  charCode(string) -> int
    Get Unicode code point of a single-character string

  foldSlices(string, string, a, (a, string -> a)) -> a
    foldSlices: Fold over split segments without materializing a list

  mapSlicesJoin(string, string, (string -> string)) -> string
    mapSlicesJoin: Split, transform each segment, and join results in O(n)

  replaceMany(string, list[(string, string)]) -> string
    replaceMany: Replace multiple patterns in a single pass

  decodeQuotedPrintable(string) -> string
    decodeQuotedPrintable: Decode RFC 2045 §6.7 quoted-printable encoding

  startsWithIgnoreCase(string, string) -> bool
    startsWithIgnoreCase: Case-insensitive prefix check

## Usage

  import std/string (length)
  -- or --
  import std/string as String

# std/json
JSON encoding for AILANG
Provides ADT for JSON values and encoding function

## Types

  [2mJSON ADT with all JSON types[0m
  export type Json = JNull | JBool(bool) | JNumber(float) | JString(string) | JArray([Json]) | JObject([{ key: string, value: Json }]) deriving (Eq)

## Exports

  encode(Json) -> string
    Encode JSON to string (Go-backed for correctness)

  decode(string) -> Result[Json, string]
    Decode JSON from string (Go-backed for correctness)

  repair(string) -> Result[string, string]
    Repair truncated/malformed JSON string (Go-backed)

  jn(()) -> Json

  jb(bool) -> Json

  jnum(float) -> Json

  jint(int) -> Json
    jint: convenience constructor for integer JSON numbers (JSON numbers are floats internally)

  js(string) -> Json

  ja(list[Json]) -> Json

  jo(list[{ key: string, value: Json }]) -> Json

  kv(string, Json) -> { key: string, value: Json }
    Helper to build object key-value pairs

  get(Json, string) -> Option[Json]
    Get value from object by key

  has(Json, string) -> bool
    Check if object has key

  getOr(Json, string, Json) -> Json
    Get value from object by key with fallback

  asString(Json) -> Option[string]
    Extract string value

  asNumber(Json) -> Option[float]
    Extract number value

  asBool(Json) -> Option[bool]
    Extract boolean value

  asBoolLoose(Json) -> Option[bool]
    Extract boolean value, tolerating a stringified boolean.

  asArray(Json) -> Option[list[Json]]
    Extract array value

  asObject(Json) -> Option[list[{ key: string, value: Json }]]
    Extract object value as key-value list

  keys(Json) -> list[string]
    Get all keys from object (in source order)

  values(Json) -> list[Json]
    Get all values from object (in source order)

  getString(Json, string) -> Option[string]
    getString: Get string value from JSON object by key

  getNumber(Json, string) -> Option[float]
    getNumber: Get float value from JSON object by key

  getInt(Json, string) -> Option[int]
    getInt: Get int value from JSON object by key (truncates float)

  getBool(Json, string) -> Option[bool]
    getBool: Get bool value from JSON object by key

  getArray(Json, string) -> Option[list[Json]]
    getArray: Get array value from JSON object by key

  getObject(Json, string) -> Option[Json]
    getObject: Get nested object from JSON object by key (returns Json)

  filterStrings(list[Json]) -> list[string]
    filterStrings: Extract string values from JSON array, skipping non-strings

  filterNumbers(list[Json]) -> list[float]
    filterNumbers: Extract float values from JSON array, skipping non-numbers

  allStrings(list[Json]) -> Option[list[string]]
    allStrings: Extract ALL elements as strings, or None if any non-string

  allNumbers(list[Json]) -> Option[list[float]]
    allNumbers: Extract ALL elements as numbers, or None if any non-number

  getStringArray(Json, string) -> Option[list[string]]
    getStringArray: Get string array from object (permissive)

  getStringArrayStrict(Json, string) -> Option[list[string]]
    getStringArrayStrict: Get string array from object (strict)

  getStringArrayOrEmpty(Json, string) -> list[string]
    getStringArrayOrEmpty: Get string array or [] if missing/invalid

  getNumberArray(Json, string) -> Option[list[float]]
    getNumberArray: Get number array from object (permissive)

  getNumberArrayStrict(Json, string) -> Option[list[float]]
    getNumberArrayStrict: Get number array from object (strict)

  getNumberArrayOrEmpty(Json, string) -> list[float]
    getNumberArrayOrEmpty: Get number array or [] if missing/invalid

  decodeFloatArray(string) -> Result[Array[float], string]
    decodeFloatArray: parse a flat JSON array of numbers ("[1.5, -2, 3e4]") straight

## Usage

  import std/json (encode)
  -- or --
  import std/json as Json
